visual_action: A montage of clips from the 2021 presidential inauguration. It shows a wide shot of the U.S. Capitol building, followed by clips of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris each taking their oath of office. It then shows them fist-bumping, Harris waving while wearing a mask, Joe and Jill Biden walking out of a building, Harris hugging Doug Emhoff, and finally both couples walking down the Capitol steps.

central_claim: The inauguration of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris two years ago was a significant and positive moment for the country.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of pride, hope, and positive remembrance of the start of the Biden-Harris administration.
